nodes.description: Complement C3-deficient mice develop much less severe disease and far less skeletal-muscle destruction despite similar inflammatory infiltrates, placing complement in the effector phase.

Viral envelope E2 N-linked glycans on infected cells are recognized by mannose-binding lectin, activating the lectin complement pathway and C3, which acts in the effector phase to destroy skeletal muscle and joint tissue. C3-deficient mice develop much less severe tissue destruction despite similar infiltrates, placing complement downstream of cell recruitment; complement activation is also detected in patient synovial fluid.

evidence.reference_title: Role of MXRA8 in Ross River Virus Disease Pathogenesis.
evidence.snippet: MXRA8 was recently discovered as an entry receptor for multiple alphaviruses including CHIKV, RRV, Mayaro virus (MAYV), and O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV).

evidence.reference_title: Role of MXRA8 in Ross River Virus Disease Pathogenesis.
evidence.snippet: MXRA8 knockout (MXRA8-/-) mice generated on a C57BL/6J background, showed abrogated disease signs and reduced viral replication, which correlated with lower viral load, diminished proinflammatory cytokines, and limited cell infiltrates in inflamed tissues.

nodes.description: No approved antiviral or disease-specific therapy exists; NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen and simple analgesics such as paracetamol are the mainstay for arthralgia and arthritis. DMARDs and corticosteroids are not proven effective.

evidence.snippet: Current treatments that address the symptoms of alphaviral infections, including RRV, include a multi-factorial approach including use of local analgesics, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and/or analgesics such as paracetamol.
